Scholarships.title: IEEE PES Scholarship Plus Initiative
Scholarships.who: US/Canada undergrads, GPA ≥3.0, power/energy focus. 244 recipients in latest cycle.
Scholarships.notes: Multi-year award. Includes direct company connections and co-op placements. One of the richest UG programs.

Scholarships.title: IEEE EDS Undergraduate Student Scholarship
Scholarships.who: IEEE EDS members, undergraduate, electron devices field. Regional quotas (R8,9,10 + R1-7).
Scholarships.notes: One of the few UG scholarships with a firm 2026 deadline confirmed. Presented by university dean.

Scholarships.title: IEEE CS Richard E. Merwin Student Scholarship
Scholarships.who: CS/EE/CE students, IEEE CS members, GPA ≥2.5. $40,000 pool total.
Scholarships.notes: Recipients become IEEE CS Student Ambassadors. Two application windows per year.

Scholarships.title: IEEE PES Erich Gunther Future Power Innovator Scholarship
Scholarships.who: IEEE PES student members, undergraduate, innovation in power/energy.
Scholarships.notes: Recognises strong innovation potential. Part of PES awards ecosystem.

Scholarships.title: IEEE PES G. Ray Ekenstam Memorial Scholarship
Scholarships.who: IEEE PES student members, undergraduate, power/energy engineering.
Scholarships.notes: Merit-based. Check PES awards page for cycle dates each year.

Scholarships.title: IEEE PES John & JoAnn McDonald Undergraduate Scholarship
Scholarships.who: IEEE PES members, undergrad, power engineering focus.
Scholarships.notes: Part of the PES Scholarship Plus family.

Scholarships.title: IEEE PES Scholarship Plus — Hoveida Family Scholars
Scholarships.who: IEEE PES members, undergrad — named scholar track within Scholarship Plus.
Scholarships.notes: New named donor track added 2025-26.

Scholarships.title: IEEE WIE Frances B. Hugle Scholarship
Scholarships.who: Women IEEE student members, all academic levels.
Scholarships.notes: Recognises academic excellence + active IEEE involvement.

Scholarships.title: IEEE WIE International Scholarship
Scholarships.who: Women pursuing advanced degrees in IEEE technical fields, global.
Scholarships.notes: Global eligibility. Strong link to WIE network which benefits YP transition.

Scholarships.title: IEEE Signal Processing Society Scholarship
Scholarships.who: IEEE SPS student members, signal processing.
Scholarships.notes: Includes SPS mentorship. Multi-year support.

Scholarships.title: IEEE Life Members Graduate Study Fellowship
Scholarships.who: IEEE members, first-year Master's students, EE field, globally recognised engineering school.
Scholarships.notes: One of the largest single-award grants. Confirmed $10,000 value (Scholarships360 verified).

Scholarships.title: IEEE Vehicular Technology Society Student Scholarship
Scholarships.who: IEEE VTS student members.
Scholarships.notes: Part of VTS student awards portfolio.

Scholarships.title: IEEE Charles LeGeyt Fortescue Scholarship
Scholarships.who: IEEE members, 1st year graduate students in EE.
Scholarships.notes: One of the highest-value IEEE scholarships. Check ieee.org for cycle.

Scholarships.title: IEEE Consumer Technology Society Student Scholarship
Scholarships.who: IEEE CTS members, undergraduate.
Scholarships.notes: Specific to consumer technology field.

Scholarships.title: IEEE EMC Society James C. Klouda Memorial Scholarship
Scholarships.who: IEEE EMCS members, electromagnetic compatibility field.
Scholarships.notes: Field-specific  EMC is growing area in EV and IoT industries.

Scholarships.title: IEEE-HKN Frank & Shelly Chang Outstanding Student Scholarship
Scholarships.who: Inducted IEEE-HKN members in an active HKN Chapter, Region 10 focus. Est. 2025.
Scholarships.notes: New scholarship established 2025. First recipient: Raghul Dayanithi (Nu Eta Chapter, India).

Scholarships.title: Upsilon Pi Epsilon Award : IEEE CS
Scholarships.who: IEEE CS members, CS disciplines. 4 awards per year.
Scholarships.notes: Academic achievement in computing. Both UG and grad eligible.

Scholarships.title: IEEE AESS Engineering Scholarship
Scholarships.who: IEEE AESS student members, EE (undergrad) or systems/EE engineering (grad), GPA ≥2.8, accredited university. No other scholarships held.
Scholarships.award: $10,000 per award : 2 UG awards + 1 grad award annually ($30,000 total pool)
Scholarships.notes: One of the largest society-specific scholarship awards. Evaluation based on application essay + financial need + 3 reference letters (2 must be professors). Funds paid to the school on behalf of the student.

Scholarships.title: IEEE PES Outstanding Student Scholarship
Scholarships.who: IEEE PES graduate student members, power & energy field.
Scholarships.notes: Separate from the PES Scholarship Plus programme. For outstanding graduate-level PES members.

Scholarships.title: IEEE PES India Scholarship Award
Scholarships.who: IEEE PES student members in India (Region 10).
Scholarships.notes: Region-specific scholarship for PES members studying in India.

Scholarships.title: IEEE Dayton Section Krishna M. Pasala Memorial Scholarship
Scholarships.who: IEEE student members in the Dayton Section (Region 2).
Scholarships.notes: Section-level scholarship. Relevant for students in the Ohio/Dayton area.

Scholarships.title: IEEE Richland Section Jim Thomas Memorial Scholarship
Scholarships.who: IEEE student members in the Richland Section.
Scholarships.notes: Section-level scholarship. Check local section page for eligibility and cycle.

Scholarships.title: IEEE Region 3 James H. Graham Cybersecurity Scholarship
Scholarships.who: IEEE student members in Region 3 (southeastern USA), cybersecurity focus.
Scholarships.notes: Cybersecurity-focused scholarship for Region 3 students.

PhD & Fellowships.title: IEEE EDS PhD Student Fellowship
PhD & Fellowships.who: PhD students, electron devices, IEEE EDS members.
PhD & Fellowships.notes: Award presented at EDS Board of Governors meeting, December 2026.

PhD & Fellowships.title: IEEE EDS Graduate Masters Fellowship
PhD & Fellowships.who: Master's students, electron devices, IEEE EDS members.
PhD & Fellowships.notes: Part of the EDS student fellowship programme alongside PhD track.

PhD & Fellowships.title: IEEE PELS Graduate Studies Fellowship (Kassakian Fellowship)
PhD & Fellowships.who: PhD students in power electronics, IEEE PELS members, global.
PhD & Fellowships.notes: Study-abroad fellowship at host institution. No country restrictions. Unique international mobility grant.

PhD & Fellowships.title: IEEE AP-S Fellowship Program
PhD & Fellowships.who: IEEE AP-S members (applicant + supervisor), global. $240,000 pool.
PhD & Fellowships.notes: Both applicant and supervisor must be AP-S members. Individual awards from a $240k pool.

PhD & Fellowships.title: IEEE AP-S Undergraduate Summer Research Scholarship (USRS)
PhD & Fellowships.who: Undergraduate students, AP-S scope, global. 16-week project.
PhD & Fellowships.notes: Requires faculty/industry supervisor. Topics must be within AP-S scope. Excellent pre-PhD stepping stone.

PhD & Fellowships.title: IEEE DEIS Graduate Fellowships
PhD & Fellowships.who: IEEE DEIS members, dielectrics & electrical insulation.
PhD & Fellowships.notes: Requires DEIS membership.

PhD & Fellowships.title: IEEE MTT-S Graduate Fellowship
PhD & Fellowships.who: IEEE MTT-S members, microwave engineering. Up to 15 fellowships/year.
PhD & Fellowships.notes: Two application windows per year. $6,000 each. Large pool  15 awards annually.

PhD & Fellowships.title: IEEE MTT-S Microwave Engineering for Medical Applications Fellowship
PhD & Fellowships.who: IEEE MTT-S members, microwave engineering applied to medical applications. Up to 3 awards.
PhD & Fellowships.notes: Interdisciplinary , bridges microwave engineering and biomedical applications.

PhD & Fellowships.title: IEEE Photonics Society Graduate Student Fellowship
PhD & Fellowships.who: IEEE Photonics Society student members. 10 fellowships.
PhD & Fellowships.notes: $5,000 each, 10 awarded annually. Total pool $50,000.

PhD & Fellowships.title: IEEE Systems Council Engineering Graduate Scholarship
PhD & Fellowships.who: IEEE Systems Council members, systems engineering.
PhD & Fellowships.notes: Also see: IEEE Systems Council James O. Gray Graduate Scholarship (separate award).

PhD & Fellowships.title: IEEE Life Members Committee History Fellowship
PhD & Fellowships.who: Graduate researchers, history of technology, IEEE members.
PhD & Fellowships.notes: Great for interdisciplinary PhDs in STS, history of science, or engineering education.

PhD & Fellowships.title: IEEE NPSS Graduate Scholarship Award
PhD & Fellowships.who: IEEE NPSS members, nuclear & plasma sciences. Deadline Jan 31.
PhD & Fellowships.notes: Relatively accessible award in a specialised field. Low competition.

PhD & Fellowships.title: IEEE AESS Robert T. Hill Best Dissertation Award
PhD & Fellowships.who: IEEE AESS members or student members, PhD awarded preferably within last 24 months, dissertation in AESS field of interest, written in English.
PhD & Fellowships.notes: Named after radar pioneer Robert Tyler Hill (1935–2014). International recognition for most outstanding AESS-field PhD dissertation. 2025 winner: Christian Curtis Jones.

PhD & Fellowships.title: IEEE PELS Joseph John Suozzi INTELEC Fellowship
PhD & Fellowships.who: IEEE PELS graduate student members, power electronics for ICT/communications systems. Global, one award per year.
PhD & Fellowships.notes: One of the highest-value single IEEE student fellowships. 2025 winner: Shubham Dhiman (NC State). Named after Dr. Joseph Suozzi, INTELEC founder. Deadline March 31 each year.

PhD & Fellowships.title: IEEE VTS Daniel E. Noble Fellowship Award
PhD & Fellowships.who: IEEE VTS graduate student members, vehicular technology field. Partially funded by Motorola endowment.
PhD & Fellowships.notes: Promotes graduate-level study in vehicular technology. Administered by IEEE Foundation.

PhD & Fellowships.title: IEEE VTS Transportation Electronics Fellowship Award
PhD & Fellowships.who: IEEE VTS graduate student members, transportation electronics technology.
PhD & Fellowships.notes: Funded by VTS endowment from 1988 Convergence Conference. Administered by IEEE Foundation.

PhD & Fellowships.title: IEEE EPS PhD Fellowship
PhD & Fellowships.who: IEEE EPS members pursuing a PhD in electronic packaging field, full-time, at accredited institution. Must have studied with advisor ≥1 year.
PhD & Fellowships.notes: Electronic packaging & semiconductor field. Self-nominations not allowed. Only one nomination per IEEE EPS member per year.

PhD & Fellowships.title: IEEE Instrumentation & Measurement Graduate Fellowship Award
PhD & Fellowships.who: IEEE IMS student members, instrumentation & measurement field.
PhD & Fellowships.notes: Supports graduate study in instrumentation and measurement. Part of IMS student awards portfolio.

PhD & Fellowships.title: IEEE AP-S C.J. Reddy Travel Grant for Graduate Students
PhD & Fellowships.who: IEEE AP-S graduate student members. Named after Prof. C.J. Reddy.
PhD & Fellowships.notes: Separate from Raj Mittra grant. Specifically for graduate students in AP-S field.

PhD & Fellowships.title: IEEE AP-S Eugene F. Knott Pre-doctoral Research Grant
PhD & Fellowships.who: IEEE AP-S members, pre-doctoral research in antennas & propagation.
PhD & Fellowships.notes: For students before PhD stage. Encourages early-career research in AP-S fields.

PhD & Fellowships.title: IEEE NPSS Glenn F. Knoll Post Doctoral Educational Grant
PhD & Fellowships.who: IEEE NPSS postdoctoral researchers, nuclear & plasma sciences.
PhD & Fellowships.notes: Specifically for postdocs , rare IEEE postdoctoral-level support.

PhD & Fellowships.title: IEEE NPSS Edward J. Hoffman Early Career Development Grant
PhD & Fellowships.who: IEEE NPSS early-career members, nuclear & plasma sciences.
PhD & Fellowships.notes: Specifically for early-career professionals. Bridge grant from student to YP.

PhD & Fellowships.title: IEEE NPSS Ronald J. Jaszczak Graduate Award
PhD & Fellowships.who: IEEE NPSS graduate student members, nuclear & plasma sciences.
PhD & Fellowships.notes: Named after Ronald Jaszczak. Part of the NPSS awards family.

PhD & Fellowships.title: IEEE PELS PhD Thesis Talk (P3 Talk) Award
PhD & Fellowships.who: IEEE PELS PhD student members. Present thesis work in video format.
PhD & Fellowships.notes: PhD students submit a video talk on their thesis. Unique format , valuable for visibility and communication skills.

PhD & Fellowships.title: IEEE PELS Graduate Studies Scholarship (Jan Abraham Ferreira Scholarship)
PhD & Fellowships.who: IEEE PELS graduate student members, power electronics.
PhD & Fellowships.notes: Named after Prof. Jan Abraham 'Braham' Ferreira. Separate from the Kassakian Fellowship.

Internships.title: WISE :Washington Internships for Students of Engineering
Internships.who: US IEEE student members, all engineering fields.
Internships.notes: Students engage Congress, White House OSTP, and federal agencies. Must write tech policy paper. IEEE membership required. Perfect bridge to YP for policy-minded engineers.

Internships.title: IEEE PES Scholarship Plus : Internship Placement
Internships.who: PES Scholarship Plus recipients  matched to power & energy companies.
Internships.notes: Scholarship recipients are directly placed with industry partners for co-op/internship. Not a standalone application.

Internships.title: IEEE History Center : Pugh Scholar in Residence
Internships.who: Graduate students with interest in history of technology/engineering.
Internships.notes: Research internship at IEEE History Center. IEEE members get priority.

Internships.title: IEEE Industry Applications Society : Myron Zucker Student-Faculty Grant
Internships.notes: Supports student-faculty collaborative design projects. Also includes travel grant component.
